svg.aria-label: Uno HC05 dual MOSFET wiring using one 1k resistor and fifteen 10k resistors

g.text: R2 is a separate 10kΩ gate pulldown.
All left ends join D6. All right ends join Q2 gate.
The bank equals 1kΩ. R13 remains a separate 10kΩ.

svg.text: Bluetooth serial · crossed TX/RX, with an RX voltage divider

g.text: Not parallel. Do not bypass R14.
VCC → +5V only for a regulated HC-05 breakout
rated for 5V input. Check the board marking.
EN / KEY and STATE: leave unconnected. Serial baud in the existing sketch: 9600.

svg.text: Every ground symbol is the SAME electrical connection:
Uno GND = HC-05 GND = battery − = Q1 Source = Q2 Source
Keep load-current returns out of the Arduino and thin signal jumpers.
+V supply connects to BOTH load positive terminals (through suitable fusing).
Load negatives connect ONLY to their respective drains—not directly to ground.
